name: gino-workspace
description: Gino host workspace — @gino/host-* SDK packages, the apps/host control plane and examples.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @gino/host-core build && bun run --filter @gino/host-store-sqlite build && bun run --filter @gino/host-channels build && bun run --filter @gino/host-hono build && bun run --filter @gino/host-serve build && bun run --filter @gino/host-proxy build && bun run --filter @gino/host build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @gino/host-core typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host-store-sqlite typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host-channels typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host-hono typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host-serve typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host-proxy typecheck && bun run --filter @gino/host typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run --filter @gino/host-core check && bun run --filter @gino/host-store-sqlite check && bun run --filter @gino/host-channels check && bun run --filter @gino/host-hono check && bun run --filter @gino/host-serve check && bun run --filter @gino/host-proxy check && bun run --filter @gino/host check && bun run --filter @gino/example-embed-node check && bun run check:node-resolution
